deltas.rationale: Failed pre-registered keep threshold: Δ Pinball = +0.108 LPA (threshold: -0.050 LPA, 95% CI: [-0.106, +0.318]). Employer target encoding provides no statistically detectable predictive benefit over discrete organizational archetypes and Mincerian experience curves.

Gate 1 Graph Feasibility: Transition network is excessively sparse (8/50 nodes with degree >= 3) in current PT1 sample. Under Charter CHARTER-EXP-10 deferral criteria, graph talent mobility modeling is formally deferred without claiming predictive improvement until B2B employer syndication tranches provide dense cross-employer mobility graphs.

graph_audit.sparsity_note: Qualified nodes with degree >= 3: 8/50 required. Total edges: 28 across 9 clusters.

executive_summary: Experiment EXP-10 evaluated 2 candidate employer feature representations against the Champion Rung F L2 baseline. Variant A (Smoothed Target Encoding) achieved Δ Pinball = +0.108 LPA (verdict: REJECT); Variant B (Talent-Flow Graph Embedding) achieved Δ Pinball = -0.053 LPA (verdict: DEFER). The mobility graph audit verified 8/50 qualified nodes. The formal production decision is DEFER. Baseline Champion Rung F with discrete organizational archetypes and k_min >= 5 cluster masking is retained without complex graph or target encoding overhead.

corrective_patch_provenance.defect_identified: Initial commit aa90169 used in-sample target transformation on train_clusters, causing observation y_i to enter row i's cluster mean.
corrective_patch_provenance.correction_implemented: transform_leave_one_out analytically subtracts y_i from cluster and tier sums, enforcing zero target leakage d(encoded_i)/d(y_i) = 0.
corrective_patch_provenance.gate_1_feasibility_enforcement: TalentFlowGraphEmbedder audited at Gate 1; unconditionally defers Variant B when qualified nodes < 50.
corrective_patch_provenance.production_champion_status: UNCHANGED (Rung F L2 Champion strictly retained)
